create_plane_parameterization: create a plane parameterization from a normal vector and a point using Geometry.vec_and_point_to_plane
compute_distance_point_to_plane: compute the shortest distance between a point and a plane using Geometry.distance_point_plane
convert_cell_to_planes: convert an ASE cell to six bounding plane parameterizations using Geometry.cell2planes with a PBC shift
derive_box_properties: derive all box properties from any two of center, length, lo_corner, hi_corner using Geometry.extract_box_properties
generate_packmol_box_structure: generate a packmol input structure string for an orthorhombic box using BoxGeometry.packmol_structure
